verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a policy template library with two tiers, Formal (Minimum Viable) and Comprehensive, and guidance on customizing template language. Its Policies page has draft policies and a 'Publish draft policies' action for drafts that don't require review, which implies an editing and review/approval workflow. Missing for 10: evidence that templates are lawyer-grade, a documented in-app policy editor, policy versioning/history, an explicit approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and independent corroboration.
